title: compliance-review-1on1-prep-draft
content:
1:1 prep -- Security & Compliance review (SOC2/ISO)
Owner: Maya Chen
Attendee: Priya Nair (audit lead)
Date: 2026-03-02 (meeting)

Purpose:
- Sync on SOC2 readiness status and narrow list of outstanding evidence for external audit.
- Confirm vendor risk exceptions and remediation timelines.
- Align on ISO27001 control mapping gaps and next steps.
- Identify immediate action owners + due dates so we can lock answers for the audit checklist.

Context / background notes:
- External SOC2 audit tentatively scheduled for late May 2026 (auditor: Clearpath Audit Co.).
- We completed internal gap assessment (Dec 2025) and remediations in infra mostly done; a few policy/evidence items still pending.
- Primary concerns: vendor risk (third-party data processors), formalized evidence for privileged access reviews, and periodic penetration testing evidence chain.

Key talking points / agenda:
1) SOC2 scope & boundaries -- confirm whether new Dedicated customers onboarded in Q1 change scope.
2) Outstanding evidence list -- prioritize items we can provide in <30 days.
3) Vendor risk exceptions -- current high/medium vendors with open POA&Ms; get agreement on mitigation timelines.
4) ISO mapping status -- any controls that still need owner assignment (esp. A.9 and A.12 areas).
5) Audit logistics -- evidence upload process, who will be the evidence SME for each control, expected cadence for auditor Q&A.
6) Quick wins to reduce auditor follow-ups before May.

Notes to self (things to surface early):
- Privileged access reviews (weekly lists) exist but not stored in a single central evidence folder. Need to confirm centralized retention path and owner (SRE? IAM?).
- Vendor risk: two vendors flagged medium-high (VaultOps, DataFlow.ai). VaultOps has contract clause pending; DataFlow.ai needs DPIA + SOC2 attestation.
- Pen test: External pen test completed Jan 2026, but remediation evidence for one medium vuln (token exposure in internal tool) is still pending verification.
- Change management: we have OKRs pointing to formalizing change logs; need PM to confirm last 6 months log export.

Questions for Priya:
- Do auditors expect SOC2 evidence packaged by control or by service? (I think by control -- confirm)
- Which vendor attestations are mandatory vs acceptable compensating controls?
- How strict are timeframe expectations for remediations discovered close to audit date?
- Any preferred structure for evidence naming/metadata to speed auditor review?

Proposed asks / requests during 1:1:
- Priya to confirm final scope by EOD next Tue (2026-03-04).
- Request that she assign auditor-facing SMEs for the 10 highest-risk controls.
- Ask for go/no-go list for items we should escalate to execs now vs after audit.

Pre-audit checklist (quick view):
- [ ] Centralize privileged access review exports -> Owner: SRE (Liam O'Connor) -> Due: 2026-03-10
- [ ] Vendor DPIA / SOC2 status for DataFlow.ai -> Owner: Procurement (Priya Nair) & Legal -> Due: 2026-03-12
- [ ] Contract clause update for VaultOps (data processing) -> Owner: Legal (Diego Martinez) -> Due: 2026-03-08
- [ ] Pen test remediation evidence upload (token exposure) -> Owner: Infra Sec (Maya Chen) -> Due: 2026-03-05
- [ ] Change management logs (last 6 months) export & retention confirmation -> Owner: Release Eng -> Due: 2026-03-09
- [ ] ISO control owner assignments (A.9, A.12) -> Owner: Security Ops -> Due: 2026-03-11
- [ ] Evidence naming convention doc (auditor-friendly) -> Owner: Security Ops -> Due: 2026-03-07

Open risks / blockers:
- Legal still drafting DP clauses for VaultOps; if not signed, may need compensating control evidence (encryption + restricted access) -- risk: medium/high.
- DataFlow.ai has no SOC2 attestation on file; procurement says they can provide ISO report but not SOC2. Risk: medium; ask auditor if acceptable.
- Centralized evidence owner not finalized; auditor will penalize inconsistent storage/metadata.

Follow-up action items (post 1:1) -- draft list to confirm with Priya:
- Priya: confirm final scope and list of auditor SMEs (due 2026-03-04).
- Maya: collect pen test remediation verification and upload to evidence folder (due 2026-03-05).
- Liam: produce privileged access weekly exports for Jan-Feb and centralize (due 2026-03-10).
- Priya + Legal: finalize VaultOps contract clause or document compensating controls (due 2026-03-08).
- Procurement: chase DataFlow.ai for DPIA/Security attestation OR prepare compensating controls write-up (due 2026-03-12).
- Security Ops: publish evidence naming conventions and sample folder structure (due 2026-03-07).

Notes-to-self (post-meeting):
- After meeting, update confluence SOC2 readiness page with agreed timeline and action owners.
- Slack channel #sec-audit-2026: ping owners with tasks and include relevant JIRA tickets (SEC-1023, SEC-1078).

Misc / scratch ideas:
- Could propose a short "audit sprint" -- 2-week focused effort to clear evidence backlog; might be worth asking for a temp resource from SRE or Release Eng.
- Consider pre-packaging a vendor risk binder (top 5 vendors) with attestations + DPIAs to cut auditor time.

End of prep notes.

-- Maya
